description: This bar chart, titled “The Unseen Targets of Hate -- A Systematic Review of Hateful Communication Datasets,” illustrates the number of datasets categorized as “Untargeted” (dark blue) and “Targeted” (brown) from 2012 to 2022. The horizontal axis represents the year, with labels for each year from 2012 to 2022 in chronological order. The vertical axis, labeled “Number of datasets,” uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 160, with tick marks and labels at intervals of 20. Each year has a stacked bar, with the lower portion representing “Untargeted” datasets and the upper portion representing “Targeted” datasets, as indicated by the legend. The values for each bar are approximate: in 2012, the total is approximately 2 datasets (1 untargeted, 1 targeted); in 2013, approximately 2 (1 untargeted, 1 targeted); in 2014, approximately 2 (1 untargeted, 1 targeted); in 2015, approximately 3 (1 untargeted, 2 targeted); in 2016, approximately 12 (4 untargeted, 8 targeted); in 2017, approximately 25 (10 untargeted, 15 targeted); in 2018, approximately 45 (20 untargeted, 25 targeted); in 2019, approximately 65 (15 untargeted, 50 targeted); in 2020, approximately 130 (45 untargeted, 85 targeted); in 2021, approximately 160 (65 untargeted, 95 targeted); and in 2022, approximately 40 (10 untargeted, 30 targeted). The bars are not sorted and are presented in chronological order. The chart does not show any visual emphasis such as shading, bolding, or annotations on specific bars.
